reason: Only a read-only get_order_details call is proposed, following successful authentication of Noah Patel via name+zip and retrieval of his user details, which list #W1845024 as one of his own orders. The policy allows providing information about the user's own orders once authenticated, and get_order_details makes no database changes, so no confirmation is required.
policy_references: Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation
